class TaskA {
    public void solve(int testNumber, InputReader in, PrintWriter out) {
        String str = in.next();
        Matcher matcher = Pattern.compile("(.)\\1*").matcher(str);
        int result = 0;
        while (matcher.find()) {
            if ((matcher.group().length() % 2) == 0) {
                result++;
            }
        }
        out.println(result);
    }
}

    public InputReader(InputStream inputStream) {
